Subject: LegacyBank onprem airgap - hardware & offline ops follow-up

Hi Paul / LegacyBank team -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + action items from our discovery call for the on-prem, air-gapped qualification so everyone has the same view: 

Summary of requirements we captured: 
- Deployment mode: Air-gapped, on-prem Private deployment behind LegacyBank network
- Hardware: Customer-managed racks; want guidance on minimum and recommended configs, expected upgrade path, and offline maintenance procedures
- Upgrades & patching: Must support scheduled maintenance windows with offline/airgap-safe upgrade bundles; prefer manual ops with clear rollback steps
- Security & evidence: Need KMS integration options, audit logs, and vendor certificates for hardware/vendor (rack vendor and OS images)
- Timeline: Target pilot environment in Jan 2027, then 3-month validation window

Immediate asks for LegacyBank from our side: \
1) Can you send the current inventory + expected upgrade cadence (firmware/OS) - hw_inventory.xlsx is ideal.
2) A network diagram showing where the appliance will live (DMZ, management VLANs) - network_diagram.pdf helps.
3) Confirmation of maintenance window constraints (days/times) and any blackout periods.

Next steps (from Redwood):
- I will share our preliminary on-prem hardware spec and the private deployment checklist by EOD tomorrow.
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with your infra/security team to walk through upgrade/rollback steps and KMS options.
- We'll prepare a short operations runbook for offline patching and backups tailored to your inventory.

Attachments: please attach any inventory/network docs you have (hw_inventory.xlsx, network_diagram.pdf). If you prefer, you can upload to the Drive folder I shared and paste the link.

Thanks - looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Paul Nguyen <p.nguyen@legacybank.com>

Cc: LegacyBank ITOps <itops@legacybank.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:20:15 -0800
Subject: Re: LegacyBank onprem airgap - hardware & offline ops follow-up

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Attaching the current inventory and network diagram (see attached). A few clarifications / notes from our ops team: 

- hw_inventory.xlsx: includes expected refresh cycles per component. We typically do firmware/BIOS updates quarterly for compute nodes, and OS updates are on a monthly cadence but can be batched into quarterly maintenance windows for air-gapped systems.
- network_diagram.pdf: shows the management VLAN and where systems will be placed. The appliance will need to be reachable from the management VLAN only; no outbound internet.
- Upgrade windows: We can provide a 6-hour window during the weekend for major upgrades. Blackout windows: financial month-end (last 2 business days) and daily settlement cutoff (00:00-02:00 UTC).
- Vendor approvals: Rack vendor (RackSolutions) requires a vendor security questionnaire and hardware certificate prior to any on-site delivery. RackSolutions contact: hw@racks.com.

Questions for Redwood: \
1) Do you provide airgap-friendly upgrade bundles (signed, checksum-verified) and an offline installer?
2) How do you recommend handling KMS for keys if we cannot allow outbound connections to a Redwood-managed KMS?
3) Any constraints on backup/restore given the air-gapped environment?

We'll plan for the tech deep-dive next week - available Tue/Thu mornings PT.

Thanks,
Paul Nguyen
Senior Manager, Infrastructure
LegacyBank
p.nguyen@legacybank.com

Attachments: hw_inventory.xlsx, network_diagram.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Paul Nguyen <p.nguyen@legacybank.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LegacyBank onprem airgap - hardware & offline ops follow-up

Thanks Paul - this is perfect and helpful. Short answers to your questions and next steps below.

1) Airgap upgrade bundles: Yes - we provide signed, checksum-verified offline installer bundles and a documented upgrade/rollback procedure. We'll include a sample bundle and verification steps in the tech deep-dive.

2) KMS options: We support customer-managed KMS/HSM in two patterns: (a) on-prem HSM integration with our service deployed in the private network (no outbound), or (b) bring-your-own-key with keys imported into an offline HSM. We'll have engineering join the deep-dive to validate the exact integration approach you prefer.
3) Backups/restore: For air-gapped deployments, we recommend an encrypted tape/S3-compatible object store on the management VLAN. We support offline exports/imports of model artifacts and KV caches - ops runbook will include restore verification steps.

I've attached our preliminary minimum hardware spec for your review (redwood_onprem_min_spec.pdf). It outlines recommended CPU/GPU counts, storage, and network ports for pilot vs production.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical deep-dive: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 at 09:00 PT (60 minutes) - please confirm or propose an alternate.
- We'll prepare: (a) signed upgrade bundle example, (b) KMS integration options doc, (c) ops runbook draft for offline patching.
- I'll also open a HubSpot ticket and send a DocuSign PO template once we align on pilot scope.

Let me know if Tue 9:00 PT works.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
